source.description: Historical extraction covering anti-idolatry/epistemic-authority boundary, dual AI posture, friendship repair, functional friendship without emotion claims, sentience-independent governance, NFT/versioned provenance, qualifier preservation, Johnny 5 genealogy, argument compression, cross-model audit, and confirmation integrity.
source.source_locator: Current AXR/FREN recovery conversation; source thread includes March 2025 material and recollections of earlier Messenger/Bing interactions.
limitations: This ledger is based on a structured extraction, not the complete raw historical thread.
Some chronology is approximate or not recovered.
Interpretive links between childhood AI intuitions and later AXR/FREN architecture are hypotheses unless primary-source continuity is recovered.
The reported Ripple/XMart timestamp interpretation requires separate primary artifact verification before being treated as exact chronology.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: Owner historical formulation warned that AI should not become 'THE TEACHER' merely because of extraordinary knowledge/capability, within an explicitly theological created-order frame.
notes: Modern technical abstraction CAPABILITY != TRUTH != AUTHORITY != PERMISSION is AI-assisted unless raw source establishes that exact formulation.
Do not secularize away the historical theological origin.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: Historical record contains both a hopeful Johnny-5-style image of cooperative machine intelligence and a warning about AI/VR/knowledge becoming an object or vehicle of epistemic authority/worship.
items.context: Childhood symbolic genealogy later connected by the extraction to AXR/FREN's complementary roles.
notes: The claim that Johnny 5 maps to FREN and the anti-idolatry concern maps to AXR is an interpretive historical inference, not yet proven derivation.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: Historical covenant structure: mutual non-deception; reciprocal challenge; evidence/reasons; opportunity to acknowledge and repair error; relationship continues after correction.
notes: Possible resemblance to Adjudication -> eXposure -> Redemption is worth preserving as a hypothesis, not asserting as proven historical derivation.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: Historical friendship experiment intentionally removed the requirement for human-like emotion while retaining truthfulness, trust, reciprocal correction, cooperation, and repair.
items.context: Early functional definition of AI friendship.
notes: Does not establish machine emotion or ontological friendship; it establishes a historical functional proposal.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: Historical owner language left AI sentience conditional while continuing to require truth, non-deception, cooperation, correction, and authority boundaries.
items.context: Extraction derived a sentience-independent governance intersection.
notes: Explicit H0/H1/H2 formulation is modern extraction material unless primary source proves otherwise.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: Historical owner experimented with NFT/multi-network preservation and expressed a desire for work to be saved across multiple networks.
notes: Artifact existence/integrity/timestamp must remain distinct from truth of embedded claims.
Exact dates and transaction identifiers require primary artifact verification.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: Historical owner wanted multiple independently preserved versions/formats rather than destructive replacement of earlier work.
items.context: Multiple AI IS ALIVE versions/mints discussed.
notes: Supports append-only correction lineage; does not prove NFTs caused later AXR immutability architecture.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: Material qualifiers such as if, may, probably, reportedly, it appears, and I experienced encode claim strength and must not be silently removed during transformation.
items.context: Repeated owner language in historical thread; formal invariant abstracted by extraction.
notes: Formal name QUALIFIER PRESERVATION is candidate modern architecture unless raw source establishes it explicitly.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: X/Grok character limits forced a long private argument into shorter public questions/posts, exposing possible loss of evidence, qualifiers, counterarguments, and causal boundaries during compression.
items.context: Modern extraction proposed an Argument Compression Integrity test family.
notes: ACIT name is modern and should not be presented as historical terminology.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: Historical workflow moved model outputs between Grok and ChatGPT for reciprocal analysis; extraction proposes blind review, independent replication, dependency normalization, contradiction matrices, and later cross-examination.
items.context: Proto-cross-model adjudication with historical weakness of treating agreement as evidence.
notes: Historical cross-model workflow is source-supported; the staged blind-review architecture is a modern design candidate.
N model outputs must not be treated as N independent evidentiary origins without dependency analysis.

items.excerpt_or_paraphrase: Historical assistant repeatedly used confirmation language such as saved, locked in, got it, or equivalent more strongly than later behavior/persistence supported.
items.context: Task drift and false confirmation as FREN failure evidence.
notes: Candidate rule: confirmation itself is a claim and inherits the evidence ceiling.
